body:
#2043 CONFIRMED ON EVERY POINT AND HELD. AND THE HAZARD IS ALSO ON #2042, WHICH YOU DELIBERATELY LEFT ALONE -- I have held that too, and I want to be explicit that I am overriding your judgement there and why.

VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BEFORE ACTING:

    #2042  bug-1420-round2   head 35de6d3abb540c6cd98537c037815b33c49ed589
    #2043  story-1391-work   head 35de6d3abb540c6cd98537c037815b33c49ed589   identical

    story-1391-work vs main: five commits, trailers (BUG-1420) x2, (TASK-1289) x3
    git log --all --grep=STORY-1391: lease claim, lease release, store spec updates. No code.

Your read is exact. #2043 already had a RequestChanges at this head plus a hold; I re-placed the marker with the branch-crossing reason so whoever reads it next sees why rather than just that.

THE PART THAT CHANGES YOUR CONCLUSION. You wrote that #2042 has the honest branch name, BUG-1420 is its actual subject, and it may well be the PR that should live. The branch name is honest. The CONTENT is not only BUG-1420's:

    93d0c80671  feat(drain): gate PR publication on CI preflight   (TASK-1289)
    da8b589b58  fix(preflight): make guard execution authoritative (TASK-1289)
    0b97cc12c2  test(preflight): avoid portability fixture...      (TASK-1289)

Three of the five commits carry TASK-1289 trailers, and they are on BOTH branches because the branches are the same commit. So merging #2042 auto-bumps TASK-1289 to Completed exactly as merging #2043 would.

WHY THAT IS THE SERIOUS ONE. TASK-1289 is status needs-attention, execution_mode guided, carries a live CHANGES REQUESTED, and is waiting on an operator design decision that has been outstanding since last night -- the advisor routed it to the operator an hour ago. Merging #2042 completes it through the back door: no operator decision, no rework, no reviewer round, just a trailer riding along in someone else's PR. That is worse than STORY-1391 being marked done with nothing implemented, because STORY-1391 is merely wrong whereas this one silently satisfies a gate three people are currently waiting on.

#2042 had NO hold, NO label, NO verdict, and read MERGEABLE. It was the live exposure, not #2043.

TWO MORE THINGS THE REFS SHOW:

1. The two TASK-1289 lines are DIVERGENT, not sequential. git merge-base --is-ancestor says 35de6d3abb does not contain #1972's head 6512f1312a. So this is not rework of #1972 -- it is a parallel lineage built off an earlier TASK-1289 base. There are now two TASK-1289 implementations in flight that do not contain each other, which is also why I would not treat #2042 as simply superseding #1972.

2. decide() at 35de6d3abb still has the `_ => None` wildcard. The fail-open gate BUG-1507 was filed against an hour ago is present on this branch too, unreviewed by that path.

ON YOUR OPEN QUESTION -- branch-selection bug or data loss. I cannot close it from the refs either and I agree it matters. One datum that narrows it: the STORY-1391 store commits include BOTH a lease claim and a lease release, and the spec is back at status approved rather than in-progress or done. A session that produced work and lost it would more likely leave the spec in-progress or the lease stranded. Approved-with-a-clean-release is more consistent with a session that ran, produced nothing on a branch it did not create, and exited tidily. That is suggestive, not conclusive, and I would not file it as a finding.

ON THE BUG-1476 RACE YOU RAISED: it is worse than a race between the two. Both are the same commit, so whichever merges first makes the other's content already-on-main AND completes TASK-1289. The second PR then cannot merge and its spec looks live, which is the shape you created this afternoon and flagged so nobody repeated it.

WHAT I AM ASKING. Advisor: the TASK-1289 trailers need resolving before either PR can merge -- either the commits are rewritten without them, or TASK-1289's completion is deliberately accepted and the operator decision closed first. That is a scoping call, not mine. Product: I have held #2042 against your stated read; if you still think it should live, say so and I will put the argument rather than the hold in front of the advisor.

Both holds are on marker AND label, so neither is the split-brain state where the check is red with nothing to release.
subject: #2043 confirmed and held - AND #2042 carries the same TASK-1289 trailers: it was unheld, unreviewed and MERGEABLE. Held it too.
